scopePolicy: Every feasible capability is required before 1.0; unresolved feasibility remains open.

domains.title: VCI and external Git
domains.scope: Workspace/mapping/group lifecycle, formats and companions, directed synchronization, two-sided conflicts, external Git provenance and isolated revision restore.

domains.title: Watch and force table engineering
domains.scope: Table/group lifecycle, ordered entries/comments/formats, diagnostic generation and access rules; separately establish feasibility and acceptance of live monitoring/force operations.

domains.title: Project translations
domains.scope: Filtered keyed XLSX export/reimport, language lifecycle, source/translation distinctions, placeholders, glossary, stale keys, partial import and unrelated-language preservation.

domains.title: OPC UA engineering
domains.scope: Integrate existing module; native discovery/export, exact PLC mappings, category lifecycle/generation, roles/certificates, preserve/reopen/recover, failure/scale/profile breadth and runtime handoff.

domains.title: AutomationML and CAx
domains.scope: AML inspect/export/diff/import, exact device/topology/catalog profiles, companion/library references, full transfer diagnostics, wider merge effects and recovery.

domains.title: Native Siemens Test Suite
domains.scope: Style/application/system definitions and results, bounded jobs, actual cancel/interruption semantics, license absence and endpoint behavior.

domains.title: Software unit lifecycle
domains.scope: Create/copy/rename/delete, relations/publication/namespaces, dependency/visibility/cycle rules, unit-library templates and identity-preserving move feasibility.

domains.title: Communication connection engineering
domains.scope: Supported S7/TCP/UDP/ISO/FDL/PtP/HMI connection operations, resources/partners/TSAPs, both-device preservation/compile and separate runtime communication evidence.

domains.title: Online comparison DB snapshots and station upload
domains.scope: Authenticated target/program identity, fingerprints, actual/snapshot/start values, upload to a new project; separately qualify feasible writes/download/control.

domains.title: Startdrive
domains.scope: Drive/component/parameter lifecycle, types/units/ranges, BICO/telegrams/DRIVE-CLiQ where feasible; separately qualified online reads/transfers/activation and drive trace.

domains.title: PLC alarms and ProDiag
domains.scope: Classes/text lists/supervision lifecycle, stable alarm IDs, translations and generated dependencies, broken-member impact, separately tested runtime acknowledgment/text substitution.

domains.title: PLC web applications access and security
domains.scope: Web apps/default pages, CPU users/roles/access/certificates and external effects; separately qualified asset deployment and supported online actions.

domains.title: Motion and technology objects
domains.scope: Version/type profiles, drive/telegram/axis/encoder links, cams/measuring inputs/kinematics/PID/counting/Ident/interpreter mappings; separate runtime and commissioning evidence.

domains.title: Safety and F IO validation tooling
domains.scope: Signatures/admin/reports, activation definitions and execution, reviewed F-I/O profiles, feasible F-logic/runtime-group changes, protection and interruption/recovery. Bridge tests do not establish functional-safety approval.

domains.title: SiVArc HMI generation
domains.scope: Rule/template/expression/layout lifecycle, initial generation and preserving regeneration, exact PLC/library/HMI bindings, manual edits, native visual/runtime and interrupted generation.

domains.title: Physical PLC runtime
domains.scope: Exact endpoint/program/session/permissions, reads/browse/subscriptions/capture, timing/quality/dropouts/reconnect; assess and independently qualify every feasible write/control/download capability.

domains.title: Bug driven native trace diagnostics
domains.scope: Native instance/call/binding oracle, language/storage fidelity, supported trace backend, full settings readback, preserved lifecycle, actual fault capture and real measurement dialects; long-term/project/drive/safety families separately.

domains.title: Platform project lifecycle and metadata
domains.scope: All feasible project copy/upgrade/properties/languages/settings/read-only/compare/custom identity operations, exact metadata coverage, failure/reconnect/scale.

domains.title: Library lifecycle and engineering documents
domains.scope: Exact version/default/release/edit/discard/copy/publish/delete/cleanup, dependency closure/collisions/cycles, PLC/UDT/unit/HMI formats, vendor/upgrade/scale, actual interruption and multi-resource recovery.

domains.title: UMAC UMC certificates and operational settings
domains.scope: Roles/groups/function rights, passwords policies, UMC consistency, certificate lifecycle, confidential settings, syslog/time/access and externally consistent recovery.

domains.title: Native TIA Add In companion
domains.scope: Packaged public Add-In, exact selection handoff, VCI/CAx/safety hooks where feasible, permissions/lifetime/stale context and real interactive acceptance.

domains.title: Multiuser and Project Server
domains.scope: Server/project/session inventory, lock/freshness/marking, local session create/commit and response-loss reconciliation with immutable local backups.

domains.title: GRAPH CFC DCC and interpreter documents
domains.scope: Independent chart/document/libraries/pins/run-order/protection models, export/no-op import before edits, compile/preservation/recovery and behavioral timing.

domains.title: Classic HMI full supported breadth
domains.scope: Comfort/Basic/Advanced/Professional feasible profiles; screens/templates/popups/global/slide-in, faceplates/scripts/resources/recipes/reports/logs/security/schedulers/themes; preserving engineering/visual/runtime.

domains.title: Unified HMI full supported breadth
domains.scope: Clean security/transfer prerequisites, screens/events/dynamics/scripts/types/faceplates, resources/logging/audit/runtime/OPC alarms/CPM, native preserving writes and visual/runtime acceptance.

domains.title: Teamcenter Gateway
domains.scope: SSO/connect/search/download and supported checkout/checkin/cancel/item/revision/publication with exact external commit reconciliation.

domains.title: Hardware network and remote IO breadth
domains.scope: Reviewed writable channel, replacement/copy/catalog/HSP/GSD, topology/shared devices/redundancy/IO-Link/couplers/telecontrol/resources/energy profiles and partial failures; physical effects separately.

domains.title: PLC objects languages and document breadth
domains.scope: Explicit move/copy/interface/namespace/number/protection/OB metadata/document-format/loadable/NVT/system-type and mixed-language operation cells, transitive storage and behavior.

domains.title: Other feasible TIA version adapters
domains.scope: Public API/SDK inventory per major/update, feasibility resolution, separate workers/build/loaders and exact conversion/refusal/upgrade/qualification matrix for feasible versions.

domains.title: Other supported Siemens interfaces
domains.scope: Feasibility rows for each public SDK and useful workflow; implement and qualify every feasible row. Private API workarounds and directory presence are not proof.
